description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Waterous is hiring an Associate Applications Developer to design, develop, implement, and support custom software aligned with its business and operational objectives. The role focuses on full-stack web development, modernizing legacy applications, integrating with the ERP system, and working with stakeholders to improve business processes.
Associate Applications Developer building full-stack C#, ASP.NET Core, and Angular applications; modernizing legacy systems and integrating ERP APIs

Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, test, implement, and maintain full-stack web applications using C#, ASP.NET Core, Angular, TypeScript, and SQL
• Analyze and modernize existing legacy applications, transitioning them to secure, scalable, and maintainable web-based solutions
• Work directly with key business stakeholders and end users to gather requirements, understand business processes, and develop software solutions
• Develop and maintain applications, REST APIs, and interfaces that integrate with the organization's ERP system and 3rd party cloud applications
• Develop new applications that improve business processes, operational efficiency, and shop floor functionality
• Write clean, efficient, well-structured, and maintainable code while following established development standards and best practices
• Independently troubleshoot, debug, and resolve software issues across front-end, back-end, and database environments
• Design, develop, and maintain relational database structures, SQL queries, stored procedures, and data integrations
• Participate in code reviews, application testing, and quality assurance activities
• Make enhancements to existing applications and recommend improvements to performance, reliability, and user experience
• Adhere to secure application development practices and ensure the confidentiality, integrity, and security of organizational data
• Utilize source control and established development, testing, and deployment processes
• Collaborate with other IT staff to ensure compatibility, reliability, and connectivity between enterprise systems
• Provide timely resolutions to application-related support tickets and project requests
• Work independently and collaboratively while demonstrating initiative, sound judgment, and accountability
• Continue developing technical skills through independent research, training, and professional development opportunities

Requirements:
• Associate degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Development, related field, or equivalent professional work experience
• 1–3 years of full-time professional software development experience
• C#, .NET / ASP.NET Core, Angular (or similar), SQL, HTML and CSS, REST APIs

Preferred:
• preferably in a full-stack web development role
